nodes.label: Student Sign-in Setup
nodes.rationale: Only the student ID is sent to a Google Apps Script which checks a Google Sheet class list and returns yes/no; the list never reaches the browser so the public repo holds no student data.

nodes.label: Setup Mode
nodes.rationale: Until checkUrl is set, any correctly formatted ID (S0 + 5 digits) can sign in.

nodes.label: Unverified Fallback When Google Unreachable
nodes.rationale: Practice must never be blocked and nothing is graded, so students get in marked unverified. Limitation: stops made-up IDs but not use of a classmate's real ID.
